messages.subject: Commodities & Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Dawn,

Kepler Search's senior work across commodities, energy, mining and infrastructure makes this a relevant introduction. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where resources strategy requires strong institutional relationships, regulatory discipline and responsible execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
